caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 AP03838 summarizes PaO1 inhibition at 17 uM/250 ug/mL and says not other bacteria tested; primary source supports 250 ug/mL PaO1 inhibition, no S. aureus inhibition, and a small significant E. coli K12 inhibition, with ug/mL as the printed unit.
Fig. 1A visually supports the APD6 mature sequence after the signal peptide, but article prose gives inconsistent precursor/mature residue counts; the APD sequence is preserved with a length caution.
The paper reports OD/CFU growth assays, EIS membrane-model disruption, TEM, and structural rationale. It does not report MIC/MBC or host-toxicity tables in local XML/PDF/supplementary material.
The local DOCX supplement contains full-length gel/blot figures for recombinant expression; landed .bin files are HTML pages. They do not change activity/toxicity/mechanism evidence.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local primary article and supplementary DOCX report antimicrobial, TEM, EIS, and purification evidence but no host hemolysis, mammalian-cell toxicity, or cytotoxicity assay results.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No host-toxicity row is asserted. This is a nonblocking absence because the previous worker-2 blocker was missing antimicrobial activity rows, which are now source-supported.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 by extracting source-supported OD/CFU/EIS activity rows, preserving APD6 activity/length cautions as source_conflict, and replacing framework-test review text with source-reviewed accepted_with_cautions adjudication.
